project.title: Using flow cytometry and metagenomics to improve the recovery of metegenome-assembled genomes in an enrichment culture from activated sludge of a wastewater treatment plant Genome sequencing
project.description: The study aimed to increase the recovery of metagenome-assembled genomes of species with lower abundances. We integrated the fluorescence-activated cell sorting and bioinformatics tools for the recovery of metagenome-assembled genomes
